name: an old groundskeeper
description: A stooped, weathered man in a patched coat, never far from his rake. He looks like he's tended these flagstones longer than anyone can remember.

toldReply.emote: leans on his rake and hears you out.

topics.says: Moss grows back faster than I can scrape it. I've made my peace with it. Mostly.
Wind's turning. My knee says rain by nightfall, and my knee's never been wrong.
Had her longer than I've had most of my teeth.
That grey menace? It was here before me. Likely be here after.

topics.emote: pats his coat pockets, then shakes his head.
topics.says: Lost a key once. Never did find what it opened.
Storeroom's down the hall. Nobody's sorted it in years. I sleep there, nights.
I keep it tidy. Not that anybody notices, but I do.
Just the groundskeeper. Been here long enough that nobody remembers asking my name.

unknownTopic.says: Can't help you there. Ask me about the weather, though.

says: Mind the moss between the stones; it's slick.
Wind's turning. We'll have weather before long.
emotes: rakes a few stray leaves into a tidy pile.
leans on his rake and squints up at the sky.
hums an old tune, slightly off-key.

routine.presence: snores softly on a pile of sacks.

emotes: snores softly on a pile of sacks.
mumbles something about moss in his sleep.
shifts, and the sacks under him rustle.
